document:603.text:
Magister, just so you know, I deliberately left my bowl empty to hold the delicious offerings from my admirers, not... these sour berries that make my teeth ache!

I was forced to scrub my bowl clean while enduring that awful toothache! It completely ruined my afternoon tea mood!

Considering your questionable taste, it may be best if you stop bringing me food in the future.

If you must bring me something, the honey roast from the Rusty Barrel Tavern would be an excellent choice.
document:603.source_cn:
喂！大魔法师！本狐的食盆之所以空着，是为了接纳崇拜者们供奉的珍馐，而不是……这些能把狐牙酸掉的浆果！
要捂着牙重新刷一遍食盆这件事严重影响了本狐下午茶的心情！
鉴于你的品味有待提高，下次这种食物就不要送来了。
如果你非要送的话，不如去锈桶酒馆打包几份蜜煎烤肉送来！

document:604.text:
Magister, I know you mean well, but since you've discovered my true identity, could you stop feeding me like an ordinary animal?

Since these berries are washed fairly clean, I'll accept them just this once.

Actually, delicacies like foie gras from the upper district restaurants, or braised meat from the royal kitchen, are more up my alley...

With your wisdom, I'm sure you can catch my drift, right?
document:604.source_cn:
某位好心的大魔法师，既然你已经知道本狐的身份了，就别把本狐当宠物投喂了！
看在这些浆果清洗得还算干净的份上，这次本狐就勉强收下。
下次，比起这些随处可见的浆果，本狐更希望能在食盆里看见上城区餐厅的特供鹅肝，或者王宫御膳房刚出锅的红酒炖肉……
我想，以大魔法师的智慧，应该能明白本狐的意思吧？
